sources.title: OLMo 2 1B: Private-Deployment Open LLM for Ops AI
sources.snippet: A compact 1B base model for private-deployment ops AI and custom fine-tuning in resource-constrained environments. OLMo 2 1B is a 1.48B-parameter transformer trained on 4 trillion tokens, sized for edge deployment and internal automation.
